The '''Oseon system''' was located within the [[Centrality/Legends|Centrality]]. It contained the [[Oseon sun|Oseon]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|belts]] of [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroids]], discovered by [[Gadfrey Oseon]] while he was fleeing the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. The [[Star system/Legends|star system]] contained no [[Planet/Legends|planets]], only seven asteroid belts, and the cause and origin of those asteroids was a mystery to [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], leading to the system becoming famous as a tourist attraction.<ref name="LCFO" />

{{System-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
While ''[[Lando Calrissian and the Flamewind of Oseon]]'' states that the Oseon system contains no planets,<ref name="LCFO" /> ''[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|Millennium Falcon]]'' contains an appearance of a planet named Oseon VII,<ref name="MF">''[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|Millennium Falcon]]''</ref> which was later confirmed by ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' to be in the Oseon system.<ref name="TEA" /> ''Millennium Falcon'' and ''The Essential Atlas'' are considered to contain the correct depiction in this regard.
